sentiment_score_definition: x <= -0.35: Bearish; -0.35 < x <= -0.15: Somewhat-Bearish; -0.15 < x < 0.15: Neutral; 0.15 <= x < 0.35: Somewhat_Bullish; x >= 0.35: Bullish
relevance_score_definition: 0 < x <= 1, with a higher score indicating higher relevance.

feed.title: Abbott Laboratories Lobbyists, 2018
feed.summary: This article details the lobbying activities of Abbott Laboratories in 2018, identifying 52 named lobbyists, 45 of whom previously worked in the federal government, including one former member of Congress. It lists the firms employing these lobbyists, such as Forbes Tate Partners and Tarplin, Downs & Young, and provides a roster of all individuals involved. The data is sourced from LD-2 reports filed with the Senate Office of Public Records, highlighting the "revolving door" phenomenon.

feed.title: Research Frontiers Welcomes Gauzy’s Court-Approved Restructuring and the Restart of SPD-Smart Light Control Film Production
feed.summary: Research Frontiers Inc. announced that its licensee, Gauzy Ltd., has received final court approval for its comprehensive debt settlement, with overwhelming creditor support. This restructuring allows Gauzy to restart production of SPD-Smart light control film in Germany and SPD emulsion in Israel, which is crucial for the SPD industry. The move is expected to benefit existing programs and advance new SPD product initiatives across various smart-glass markets.

feed.title: eBay VP Blair Ethington Departs As Seller Leadership Questions Return

Her departure highlights ongoing concerns about eBay's focus on C2C and its potential impact on business sellers, especially as the company increasingly promotes its owned platforms like Depop.

feed.title: Can Newmont GoldCorp (NYSE:NEM) Adapt As The Gold Market Shifts?

feed.title: Walmart Vs Kroger: Jim Cramer Couldn’t Figure Out Why Only One’s Shares Went Up
feed.summary: Jim Cramer expressed confusion over why Walmart's shares rose despite negative earnings, while Kroger's stock did not react positively to its own earnings report. Both companies faced challenges, with Kroger cutting its full-year sales growth guide and Walmart experiencing its slowest comparable sales growth in five years, yet both saw strong advertising revenue. Walmart's higher forward P/E ratio and lower short interest, compared to Kroger, suggest differing investor perceptions despite similar underlying business challenges regarding consumer spending.

feed.title: Here’s When Jim Cramer Thinks Costco Wholesale Corporation (NASDAQ:COST) Will Cut Prices

Despite the weakness, Cramer defends Costco, citing its ability to use scale and the potential for price cuts as reasons for optimism. feed.title: CVS Health is making a difference in local communities, one classroom at a time
feed.summary: CVS Health and Aetna partnered with community organizations and sports teams to provide over 5,000 backpacks filled with school supplies to students in need across various states. These initiatives aimed to remove learning barriers, foster confidence, and support families during the back-to-school season. This effort reflects CVS Health's broader commitment to community engagement and making a meaningful difference in local communities.

feed.title: Huntington Bancshares Cuts 2027 Outlook as Margin, Loan Growth Pressures Mount
feed.summary: Huntington Bancshares (HBAN) has lowered its 2027 EPS outlook to $1.75–$1.83, citing increased funding costs, deposit competition, and reduced loan growth. The company expects net interest margin to remain in the low-to-mid 3.20% range and plans to increase its 2027 share repurchase program by $200 million, leveraging capital freed up by slower loan growth. Despite the revised outlook, management anticipates over 20% EPS growth from 2025 levels and aims for a return on tangible common equity in the high 17% range by 2027.

feed.title: ‘Sweet Magnolias’ Canceled at Netflix After Five Seasons
feed.summary: Netflix has canceled its drama series "Sweet Magnolias" after five seasons due to declining viewership. However, showrunner Sheryl J. Anderson and star JoAnna Garcia Swisher are developing a new series for Netflix called "Ladies of the House," based on a novel by Lauren Edmondson, with both involved as executive producers and Garcia Swisher potentially starring. The new show will focus on a family owning a winery, navigating challenges after the owner's unexpected death.

feed.title: NVIDIA Vs Intel Corporation (NASDAQ:INTC): Here’s The One Jim Cramer Likes
feed.summary: Jim Cramer has expressed a preference for Intel (NASDAQ:INTC) over NVIDIA, citing Intel's strong year-to-date gains and higher valuation. Despite NVIDIA's dominance in AI GPUs, Cramer believes Intel's foundry business and focus on agentic AI CPUs position it well for future demand, especially in areas like robotics and autonomous driving. However, Intel faces challenges with significant capital expenditure for its foundry segment, while NVIDIA continues to see strong demand for its AI chips, reflected in its robust data center revenue growth.

feed.title: Huntington Bancshares Cuts 2027 Outlook as Margin, Loan Growth Pressures Mount
feed.summary: Huntington Bancshares (HBAN) has revised its 2027 earnings outlook downward to $1.75-$1.83 per share, citing persistent pressures from higher interest rates, increased funding costs, and intense competition impacting net interest margin and loan growth. The bank also announced plans to boost its 2027 share repurchase program by $200 million, to a range of $1.3 billion to $1.4 billion, leveraging capital freed up by slower loan growth. Despite the challenging environment, Huntington expects strong growth in fee-based businesses and successful integration synergies to partially offset these headwinds.

feed.title: Oracle's $18 billion data center debt under pressure, FT reports
feed.summary: Oracle's $18 billion in loans for its New Mexico data center, "Project Jupiter," are reportedly under pressure, with syndicate banks quoting them at a discount. This comes amid local opposition due to water supply and air quality concerns, and stalls in selling the debt to broader investors over Oracle's rising borrowing and weakening creditworthiness. Oracle is expanding rapidly into AI infrastructure, increasing its debt load, and faced a setback when its request for a natural gas pipeline to power the data center was blocked.

feed.title: Vistra Corp (VST) — Power Infrastructure Play for Data Centers Beyond Nuclear

feed.title: Webuy Global receives Nasdaq minimum bid price deficiency notice By Investing.com
feed.summary: Webuy Global Ltd. (NASDAQ:WBUY) has received a notice from Nasdaq indicating its Class A ordinary shares failed to meet the minimum bid price requirement of $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days. feed.title: Delta returns to Monterey after nearly 20 years

The airline will offer nonstop flights to Los Angeles and Salt Lake City, providing Central Coast travelers with access to two major western hubs and connecting them to numerous domestic and international destinations.

feed.title: Lockheed Martin wins $871 million F-35 contract modification

feed.title: Hubbell acquires Nicor (water metering) for ~$56M (SEC)

This information comes from a Hubbell Form 10-Q filing with the SEC. It is important to note that this Nicor is not the LED lighting company nicorlighting.com.
